In order to cancel pending reception in lower-layer, related to the lower priority request, the Dcm module shall call PduR_DcmCancelReceive () with the following parameters: PduId: the id of the Pdu to be canceled
If the Dcm is preempting a protocol with a pending reception, the Dcm module shall call cancel that reception with PduR_DcmCancelReceive().
If the Dcm is preempting a protocol with a pending reception, the Dcm module shall call cancel that reception with PduR_DcmCancelReceive().
